issue.title: Use tall coloring-page art on portrait native paper
issue.body:
**What:** Native paper now takes the screen's shape (#2775), but native ships only the wide coloring art. On an upright phone a coloring page is a wide picture centered on a tall sheet, and Magic on book art reveals nothing in the empty bands above and below it.

**Where:** check how the shipping app picks art per canvas orientation (its coloring overlay and pack variants), then compare with `experiments/native-architecture/src/drawing/bundledBookAssets.ts`, `src/offlineLibrary/` and `pageArtTransform`. See the ADR-0050 amendment.

**Done when:** a portrait drawing on a coloring page uses the tall variant, if the shipping app has one, on web, Android and iOS, with Magic covering the page.

Part of #2690.
